text: Anthony Kittel, Project Manager, Strategic Initiatives, Policy and Analysis (SIPA), Infrastructure and Development Services, City Planning will provide an overview of the Productions, Interactive, Creative (PIC) Core Urban Design Guidelines draft, the including the integration of results from consultations with film industry stakeholders and members of the Toronto Film, Television and Digital Media Board and the Film Office as well as the next steps for the document.
The Film, Television and Digital Media Advisory Board received the item for information.
